speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I'm getting worried.
He missed half of the session...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...and there's still no word from him.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - No answer at his home either.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Your Honor, what do you think
is going on with him?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
He's been late for work
four days in a row.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: He looks like he hasn't slept in a month.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Maybe he's holding down a second job.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Could be right. Could certainly
explain his behavior.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
But what kind of a job
could be taking so much out of him?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Oh, ship's anchor, Little League
backstop, that sort of thing.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Maybe he just pulls people around...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...in hansom cabs
when the horses get tired.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I don't think that's very funny. I mean,
if the poor guy's got money problems...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
He doesn't have that same sparkle
in his eyes anymore.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Yeah, and the zip's kind of gone
out of his lumbering.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
He looks it. There he is.
Hey, Bull, over here!

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Ever see Night of the Living Dead?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Okay, so he's a little cranky.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Only one more case, Your Honor.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...I realize I've only been here
one week, but...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Bull, we are in court.
You might wanna call me judge.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
We're all real concerned about you,
because, quite frankly...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - More so than usual, Your Honor?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
You've been late all week,
you missed half of the session tonight...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...and when you're here, you're not here.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Bull, just between us,
would a loan be in order?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I meant I would loan you money.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I just wanna help you out of this problem
that's affecting your work.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
It won't affect my work anymore, sir.
I assure you.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Bull, as a friend, I'm concerned...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
You don't wanna talk about it? Fine.
You don't have to. Resume your duties.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I'm going to go over there now...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Your Honor, did you find out anything?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Yeah. What's the abominable Boy Scout
up to now?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Can we get on with the case
and get out of here?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: May I remove my coat, Your Honor?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
You almost got me on that one,
didn't you, Mr. Reynolds?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
That charge is ridiculous, Your Honor.
I'm not a pervert.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Mr. Reynolds, what you do in the privacy
of your own home is one thing...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...but what you do
at the Chock Full o'Nuts...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...at Fourth and Lexington
is quite another.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
That was the point, Your Honor.
To bring the subject out into the open.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Your Honor, what Mr. Reynolds
apparently created was a stampede...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...when he stood atop
the coffee counter, disrobed...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Don't you see?
Our clothing inhibits us, people.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Nudity allows us
to be open to each other.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Great little icebreaker, no doubt.
But, Mr. Reynolds...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...quite frankly, I don't wanna
know you that well.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
All I can say is, if you don't go nude,
you're missing a wonderful experience.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Well, I'm gonna describe it
as a Class A misdemeanor...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...and I'm gonna fine you $ 160.
And if there's any further...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - He fell asleep. Then he fell over.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
How could anybody fall asleep
standing on their feet like that?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - You better check under him for survivors.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Let's get him into your office.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Thanks for giving us a hand with Bull.
We really needed the help. Thank you.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Thank you. Thanks a lot.
Thank you. Thank you very much.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Thank you. You might wanna see
a doctor about that. Thank you.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Thank you. Thank you very much.
Thank you. Right. Thanks. Thanks.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - It's okay, Bull. You just fell asleep.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
You're in my office. We're all here:
Selma, Charlie, Liz...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Remember what he did
to the candy machine?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
You guys need anything
while we're out?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
No? Okay, listen,
hey, take care, big guy.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Come on. Not in front of everybody.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Bull, I know that your private life
is just that: It's private.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
But when you've got a problem
interfering with your job...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Listen, everybody. I appreciate
your concern, I really do.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
But it's something I don't wanna talk
about now. Can't you understand that?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Bull, it's true
I don't know you very well...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...and... Well, maybe it's not my place...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...but I find that when I have a problem,
sometimes it really lifts my spirits...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...just to do something nice for myself...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...like have a manicure,
buy a new dress...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I hate to keep pressing the point,
but until I find out what's going on...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I'll be right there. I gotta go home.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Bull, get back here
until I'm finished talking!

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Your Honor, I can't! My baby needs me!

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
If some girl got him in trouble,
she's gonna answer to me.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I wonder which one is Bull's.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Open up before I kick it in.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
My, what a proportionate
place you have.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Bull, what is this about a baby?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Baby? Did I mention a baby?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Bull, where did that baby come from?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
You don't know
where babies come from?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
You know what I mean.
I mean, whose baby is it?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
A friend asked me to watch him
while she went on a job interview.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - She abandoned this child, didn't she?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - She did not abandon the child.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Come on. I didn't do anything.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
He's hungry. I gotta go get some food
at the corner store.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I don't know nothing about
watching no babies.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
The only thing domestic about me
is my perfume.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I'll go to the store. What do you need?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Just some baby food. Assorted
vegetables, fruits, that kind of thing.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I gotta go warm his formula.
Watch him, Your Honor.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Perhaps he needs to be changed.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
The stuff's there
on the table by the lamp.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - No, Bull. I don't think I can.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Okay, Ernie. I'm just gonna
undo these pins...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Oh, my God. I got it. I got it. I got it!

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Powder his bottom, affix the new diaper,
and you're done.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: ...affix the new diaper, and I'm done.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Okay, Ernie. I think we got it here. One.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
You attached him to the mattress,
Your Honor.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Boy, does this bring back memories.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I haven't bought
strained peas since 1966.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Oh, yeah? Who was the little critter?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Come on, little munchkin. Chow time.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Bull, we've gotta talk about that child.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Get that, would you, Your Honor?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - I can't wait to see his bath towels.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Guys, I'm afraid we have
a real problem in there.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Charlie said something about a baby.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Bull's neighbor left her baby with him
while she went off to a job interview.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
That was five days ago,
and she hasn't been back since.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
But Mr. Mary Poppins in there
won't believe it.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: My, my. This is very nice.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Hey, would you look at this?
He's got cable.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - How sweet. Is it a him or a her?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I made it myself. Durable, inexpensive,
easy to patch.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: He's got a 16-slice toaster out there.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Over there, just left of the grain elevator.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: It's time we discussed the child.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Bull, I'm afraid that Ernie is susceptible
to more than just drafts.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Bull, his mother isn't coming back.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: What's the matter with you people?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
How could anybody possibly abandon
a helpless little guy like this?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
You work in a courtroom.
You see this all the time.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
There are desperate,
emotionally stressed people...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...capable of doing things they would
not do if they were healthy.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: That rumbling? That's just a train.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Did I mention the door sticks?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Oh, Dan! Are you all right?!

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I think I swallowed my eyes.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Doesn't that train noise
affect the baby?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Mary's apartment's just down the hall.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Bull, Mary is not coming back.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Your Honor, I know this woman.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: And I know she's coming back.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
All right. Suppose for a moment
that she isn't. Then what?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Then you'll what? You're gonna
go on with this for 18 years?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: What do you want me to do?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I'll make out a court order,
and we'll contact the proper authorities.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: If he's going on a trip...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: He won't leave home without it.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - I got a key to her apartment here.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Give it to me. I'll go.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Around the corner, number two.
Mr. Boogee's in the playpen.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I'm going in the kitchen
to have a cigarette.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Let the kid learn his bad habits
in school, like everybody else.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: You have gotta see that tub.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Bull, the life preserver,
that's for guests, right?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: If this were a banana, I'd be dead.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: What are you doing by that door?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Nothing. L... I'm just looking for a friend.
I'm just...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Actually, I prefer cloth diapers
to the other products if I have the time.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Although other mothers
may tell you different.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Bull, I ran into a friend of yours.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: He was right. She came back.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Till a year ago, he believed
in the Easter Bunny.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - I guess I should start with thank you.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Although I was starting to get a little
worried. Well, not real worried, but...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I was wondering if something
happened to you.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
No, nothing happened. I just
got a little lost for a while.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Where do you get lost for six days?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I really did go for that job interview
like I said.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
But then after that... I don't know.
I just kept going.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Sometimes it's tough enough just trying
to take care of yourself, much less...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - Being a mother is not an easy job.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
But I started to realize,
"What am I doing?"

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
...because I'd left him. And that made
it even harder to come back.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
But I wanted to be with him.
L... I wanted to say to him:

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I wanted to hug him and just say:

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
But what happens if he grows up
and finds out that l...?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: That you got delayed? So what?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Am I going to be arrested?

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
It's not actually abandonment,
since you did leave him...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - She'll stay with him, Your Honor.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: - I will. Believe me, I will.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: Just like I knew she'd come back.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I wish Ernie had
had a father just like you.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: If you ever start to get lost again...

speaker: UNKNOWN
text: I know a couple of shortcuts out of here.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Come on, everybody. Let's go
and let this boy get some sleep.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
I just want to thank you all
for being concerned about me.

speaker: UNKNOWN
text:
Let's go get some coffee.
I got to tell you about his toilet seat.
